$Comment: The Greater Disenchanting Table's hum, the looping ambient sound its Working and Drawing block states play (Item/Items/RPG_Station_Disenchanting_Table_Greater.json). Parent SFX_Portal_Neutral supplies the two looping portal layers and the ambient category; this file quiets and lowers them and adds the ducking rules the vanilla Memories bench uses, so the music dips and the room's block and creature sounds fall away while a ritual runs. Those rules would also swallow the ritual's own accents, so every accent in a ducked category plays through a copy with BypassDucking set (RPG_SFX_Disenchant_Crystal_Break, RPG_SFX_Disenchant_Void_Summon, RPG_SFX_Disenchant_Void_Despawn). A looping event belongs on a block state and nowhere else: nothing can stop one fired from a step.
